text_block_list.text:
Starting today is the "Summer Training 
Camp"— Intensive training to improve 
skills begins.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Mr. Sun sure is energetic today. It's a 
bit too dazzling for a creature of the 
shade like me...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'm already starting to worry whether we 
can make it through in one piece.
choice_data_list:
We've got the Kokura Kinen too, so we 
gotta do our best.

We've got the Kokura Kinen too, so we have 
to do our best.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"No, that's just the thing. A race during 
a training camp is way too much packed 
together."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Kokura is pretty far from here too, so 
that'll cut down on our training time...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"She's already out of reach as it is, and 
now she's gonna leave me even further 
behind."
choice_data_list: Alright, let's dash to Kokura then!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, nice, nice! Running counts as training 
too, so it kills two birds with one stone.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It's only around 1,000 km, right? Alright, 
no sweat—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"As if! Where'd that come from all of a 
sudden?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Is this Trainer actually... totally into 
this...?

And so, our fiery summer training camp 
with Nice Nature began.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah, pretty hot would be great, please~
